meta: 5 traps everyone has fallen into when using AI: the more confident AI sounds, the easier it is to fall for it.

muc.title: Five common traps
muc.text: The more confident AI sounds, the easier it is to fall into a trap. These are the five most common ones.

muc.title: Made-up numbers, fake voices
muc.text: One: AI makes up numbers and still sounds sure, so check the source. Two: scammers fake a relative's voice, so call back on a number you know.

muc.title: Pasting data, trusting detectors
muc.text: Three: pasting your ID or bank account number into a chatbot. Four: trusting AI-writing detectors, which often guess wrong.

muc.title: Letting AI decide for you
muc.text: Five: letting AI decide about health, money or legal matters. AI helps you understand; qualified people decide.

muc.title: Clean up your chat history
muc.text: Open your chatbot history, find chats where you pasted personal information, and delete them.
